title: Jolt: Performance monitors always returns 0
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f)
- Present since Jolt was merged, 4.4.stable has the same problem

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X3D 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 62.00 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

After selecting Jolt as physics engine on my project, `Performance.get_monitor()` started returning 0 for `PHYSICS_3D_ACTIVE_OBJECTS`, `PHYSICS_3D_COLLISION_PAIRS` and `PHYSICS_3D_ISLAND_COUNT` despite clearly having simulated bodies. The monitor panel of the debugger showed the same issue.

This seems to be cause by a stub in `JoltPhysicsServer3D::get_process_info()` (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8898c2b3db32adf6f92c694ffb6dac19af672e5f/modules/jolt_physics/jolt_physics_server_3d.cpp#L1688):
```cpp
int JoltPhysicsServer3D::get_process_info(ProcessInfo p_process_info) {
      return 0;
}
```

Happy to open a PR to implement. 

### Steps to reproduce


1. New project, set the physics engine to `Jolt`.
2. Add a `StaticBody3D` floor and some `RigidBody3D` boxes stacked.
3. Attach this script to the root node  and run:

```gdscript
extends Node3D

func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
      if Engine.get_physics_frames() % 60 == 0:
              print("active=%d pairs=%d islands=%d" % [
                      Performance.get_monitor(Performance.PHYSICS_3D_ACTIVE_OBJECTS),
                      Performance.get_monitor(Performance.PHYSICS_3D_COLLISION_PAIRS),
                      Performance.get_monitor(Performance.PHYSICS_3D_ISLAND_COUNT),
              ])
```

4. Using Jolt will print: `active=0 pairs=0 islands=0` every second.
5. Switch physics engine back to `GodotPhysics3D` and run again: the three values are non-zero


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Godot-MRP-Jolt-Performance-Monitor-main.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32235454/Godot-MRP-Jolt-Performance-Monitor-main.zip)

Repository: https://github.com/JulienLavocat/Godot-MRP-Jolt-Performance-Monitor
